lines.en: Chewing on rotten lips as it moves
Chomping on bones on the ground

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤下骨头吱吱响
腐烂的肌肉在骨头间移动

lines.en: Chomping on rotting flesh on the ground
My knee bends backwards and I still run.
When I run, I lean even more than when I walk.
Chomping on a bone in its hand

lines.zh: 我站在废墟里，慢慢转着圈。
lines.en: I stand in the ruins and turn in slow circles.

lines.zh: 咬咬自己的手，发出嘶嘶声
lines.en: Sssss, gnawing on its own hand

lines.zh: 摇摇晃晃地站着，似乎随时会倒下
盯着你看，眼中闪烁着贪婪
lines.en: Staring at you with greedy eyes
Staring at you, waiting for you to get closer

lines.zh: 我跑起来鞋都掉了一只。
lines.en: I lost a shoe the last time I ran.

lines.zh: 我歪着脖子，看你的喉咙。
lines.en: My head lolls as I look at your throat.
Looking at you, filled with hatred
Staring at you, showing its fangs
Staring at you, as if it will pounce

lines.zh: 盯着你，眼中闪烁着欲望
lines.en: Staring at you, with desire in its eyes
Staring at you, ready to attack

lines.zh: 小腿折成奇怪的角度，仍在动。
lines.en: My shin bends at a strange angle and keeps moving.

lines.zh: 饥饿啃着我的胃壁，我照样跑。
lines.en: Hunger gnaws my stomach lining; I run anyway.

lines.zh: 跑着跑着，腿就不听使唤。

lines.en: Starved for flesh, meat is life.

lines.zh: 被遗忘的角落，我的乐园。

lines.en: The call of hunger, never sated.
Pain in collision, worse than death.
Pressure on rotting flesh intensifies pain.

lines.zh: 碰撞中的折磨，无从逃避。
lines.en: Pain from collisions, nowhere to escape.

lines.zh: 碰撞中的痛苦，无从避免。

lines.en: Bump into me and you are already bitten.
The can you dropped is mine first.

lines.zh: 我跑起来连自己都停不住。
lines.en: Once I run, even I can't stop.

lines.zh: 别翻我的东西，被咬的伤口还在渗。
lines.en: Do not rummage through my things; the bite still seeps.
I’m going to eat your leg.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的样子，正好够到。
lines.en: You bend over at just the right height.
I run far faster than a walker.

lines.zh: 我这条腿还能跑，追你够。
lines.en: This leg still runs — enough to catch you.
Once running, I don't slow at corners.

lines.zh: 我从街角转出来，直奔你。
lines.en: I turn the corner and come straight for you.
You smell better when you run.
I smell the wound on you.
Do not look back. I will be following.
This body only wants to bite.

lines.zh: 活人的脚步，一点拖沓都没有。
lines.en: A living person's steps never drag.
I’m going to drink your blood.

lines.zh: 第三十五号，今晚只追一个。
lines.en: Number thirty-five hunts only one tonight.

lines.zh: 你的骨头会是我的武器。
lines.en: Your bones will be my weapon.
When I run, my own legs can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我的指头断了两根，照样抓。
lines.en: Two of my fingers are broken; I still grab.

lines.zh: 我会咬你的小腿，先断腿。
lines.en: I bite your calf. The leg breaks first.

lines.zh: 你包扎也没用，血还在流。
lines.en: Bandage it all you like, the blood still flows.
I chase without rest. I do not sleep.
I bite the hand first, then you have no weapon.
Even if I fall, I will crawl to you.
Turn around. The neck is right there.

lines.zh: 我来完成你未竟的旅程！

lines.en: One bite and the bleeding will not stop!
My teeth are packed with shredded meat!
This bite takes skin and flesh!
You will not heal this wound!
Your screaming will bring more of us!
Fast as I run, I still need meat.

lines.zh: 这双腿还在，我就一直跑。
lines.en: While I have these legs, I keep running.

lines.zh: 废墟里爬出第三十五号。
lines.en: Number thirty-five crawls out of the ruins.

lines.zh: 地上的血迹把我引来了。
lines.en: The bloodstains on the ground led me here.
I used to be a living man.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的头发，一股焦味。
lines.en: Fire catches my hair; the smell of burning is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从废墟二层摔了下来。
lines.en: I fell from the second floor of the ruins.

lines.zh: 水灌满我的肺，我照样走。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; I walk on anyway.
Broken glass is lodged in my back.

lines.zh: 一支箭从背后钉进我的肩。
lines.en: An arrow nails into my shoulder from behind.

lines.zh: 雷落下来时，我的血还在流。
lines.en: When the bolt fell, I was already bleeding.
